text: Wispr Flow is a great app where you can easily list things up, change your mind, and Wispr Flow does its job. It's really easy to use: just tap on the button and it will record your message. It takes less than 2 seconds. Also Wispr Flow uses punctuation. Like if you say "exclamation mark, exclamation mark, will appear and if you say "laughing emoji," the emoji will come. And can you imagine? I recorded all of this with Wispr Flow in just 1 minute but it would have taken 3 minutes to type.
